title: REACT: A Fully Spiking State-Space Model for Real-Time Event-Driven Temporal Perception
description:
arXiv:2609.19204v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Robotic systems operating in dynamic environments require visual perception that evolves continuously with the incoming sensory stream. Event cameras provide microsecond temporal resolution and asynchronous sensing, but most learning-based methods accumulate events into frames or temporal bins, introducing an integration delay that can limit fast reaction.
